nodes.description: Base URI string used to build token metadata URIs; set by owner via setBaseURI.
Token metadata extension ('.json'); set by owner via setBaseExtension.
Mint price = 1 ether; checked in mintFLEX.
Maximum FLEX supply (1111); gates minting and triggers grand prize branch.
Timestamp equal to deployment block.timestamp + 7 days; gates withdraw.
Payable mint entrypoint; performs random gift payout call and fixed commission call.
Owner-only withdrawal that forwards entire contract balance to msg.sender.
Pseudo-random number generator based on keccak of block.timestamp, msg.sender and seeds modulo _mod.
Sets base URI and self-mints token 1 to the deployer.
Owner-only setter for baseURI.
Owner-only setter for baseExtension.
Returns metadata URI concatenating baseURI, tokenId and baseExtension.
Internal override returning baseURI.
View helper returning all token ids owned by an address.
Caller-controlled address used as minter and gift receiver.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as randomness seed and as withdraw gate.
External call transferring giftValue to a randomly selected owner inside mintFLEX; reentrancy and arbitrary-recipient risk.
External call sending 15% of msg.value to a hardcoded address; failure can revert mint.
External call forwarding full contract balance to owner in withdraw.
Arithmetic computing giftValue as balance*10/100 or msg.value*10/100.
Predictable on-chain randomness derived from block.timestamp and msg.sender.
Local cache of totalSupply() inside mintFLEX.
Recipient of the random gift payout inside mintFLEX.
Amount of the random gift payout inside mintFLEX.
Owner address parameter of walletOfOwner.
Modulus parameter of randomNum.
Seed parameter of randomNum.
Salt parameter of randomNum.
Constructor parameter setting initial base URI.
Token id parameter of tokenURI.
New base URI parameter of setBaseURI.
New base extension parameter of setBaseExtension.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the minter and as the fallback gift recipient in mintFLEX.
block.timestamp is used as the randomness seed in randomNum, making it timestamp/randomness dependent.
headStart is computed from block.timestamp at deployment and later gates withdraw.
cost is compared against msg.value in the mintFLEX payment check.
maxSupply bounds supply+1 in mintFLEX and triggers the grand prize branch.
mintFLEX invokes randomNum to select the gift recipient.
mintFLEX performs an external value call to the randomly chosen giftAddress, allowing reentrant control transfer.
mintFLEX performs an external value call paying the fixed 15% commission.
mintFLEX computes giftValue with balance*10/100 and msg.value*10/100 arithmetic.
Local supply value from totalSupply() drives mint, random draw and payout logic in mintFLEX.
giftAddress is the target of the external gift transfer call.
giftValue is the amount sent in the external gift transfer call.
withdraw forwards the full balance via an external call, exposing reentrancy on the withdrawal path.
withdraw uses block.timestamp compared to headStart as its release condition.
withdraw sends the balance to msg.sender.
The external gift transfer can re-enter mintFLEX before completion (callback into the caller).
The external balance transfer in withdraw can re-enter withdraw before completion.
randomNum derives its output from block.timestamp and msg.sender, producing predictable weak randomness.
_mod parameter is used as the modulo bound in randomNum.
_seed parameter is hashed into the pseudo-random computation.
_salt parameter is hashed into the pseudo-random computation.
_newBaseURI parameter is assigned to baseURI in setBaseURI.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
_newBaseExtension parameter is assigned to baseExtension in setBaseExtension.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension state variable.
_initBaseURI constructor parameter is passed to setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter selects the token metadata in tokenURI.
_owner parameter selects which owner's tokens are enumerated.
msg.sender (deployer) receives the initial self-minted token in the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: Local supply is a temporary cache of totalSupply() that only feeds mintFLEX payout logic.
giftAddress exists solely as the destination of the external gift transfer call.
giftValue exists solely as the amount of the external gift transfer call.
_owner is a transient input parameter of the walletOfOwner view helper.
_mod only bounds the modulo inside randomNum.
_seed only feeds the keccak randomness computation in randomNum.
_salt only feeds the keccak randomness computation in randomNum.
_initBaseURI only flows through the constructor into setBaseURI.
tokenId is a transient selector parameter of tokenURI.
_newBaseURI is the transient input assigned to baseURI.
_newBaseExtension is the transient input assigned to baseExtension.
